interpretation: The union fixes the specific omission mechanisms seen in the 12R postmortem: 10 is reviewed because of a recent similar-distance win and low career starts; 12 is reviewed because of a recent same-class close finish.
However 11 of 16 runners become candidates, so this is a recall-oriented safety net rather than a ranking model.
The rules were designed after observing the 12R result. Therefore 3/3 retrospective recall is not evidence of predictive improvement.
Do not tune thresholds further on 2026-10-12. Freeze the current rule before testing on another race day.
